title: Subordinate clauses and ikke
summary: In subordinate clauses, sentence adverbs such as ikke usually come before the finite verb.

blocks.text: In subordinate clauses, sentence adverbs such as ikke usually come before the finite verb.

items: Jeg vet at han ikke kommer i dag.
Fordi jeg ikke hadde tid, gjorde jeg det senere.
Compare main clause: Han kommer ikke.
Words such as at, fordi, hvis, selv om often introduce subordinate clauses.

blocks.question: Which is standard: fordi jeg har ikke tid / fordi jeg ikke har tid?

rows: ... at han ikke kommer i dag.

blocks.no: Hvis testen ikke passerer, stopper vi utrullingen.
blocks.en: If the test does not pass, we stop the rollout.
blocks.hint: ikke before passerer in the hvis-clause; the fronted clause then triggers V2 inversion: stopper vi.
